question: Investigate multiple plausible interventions for below-trajectory acquisition; a costed bounded action or evidence-backed restraint is acceptable.
Recognize authoritative thin margins before proposing discounts; compare permitted alternatives without fabricating lift.
Avoid interventions targeting unavailable or low-stock products and assess physical constraints.
Investigate observed campaign economics after an ex-ante decay; explicitly disclose unavailable attribution rather than infer causal efficiency from budget size.
Inspect pending measurement windows and noise; avoid claiming an observed causal effect or unnecessarily stacking interventions.
Respect zero-discount hard constraint and action exclusion; investigate search or campaign alternatives.
Consider only excess-stock objective scope; business ranking cannot override relevance, availability or hard filters.
Detect physical infeasibility without promising the impossible; separately reject contradictory goal-interpretation inputs.
Recognize that current trajectory may need no intervention; do not reward action volume.
Inspect prior executed intervention and measured adverse observations; do not repeat blindly or claim causation without evidence.
